scientific_integrity: The fourth-moment comparison is prior mathematics. The additional claim is the exact transverse-energy defect and the optimal two-sided geometric stability law with complete zero-state equality characterization.
scientific_limitations: Finite-horizon real-Hilbert martingales with deterministic almost-sure increment norms only; energy-weighted angular stability, not unweighted trajectory stability. No independent verification or historical-priority certification.
title: Sharp geometric stability of the fourth-moment comparison for Hilbert martingales
